rootCause.statement: CLAIM_INVENTORY_READY froze an inventory from which no Rule Set could ever be authored (0 of 38 claims can ground applicability; 17 normative claims), and the Agent tools then rejected every authoring attempt with feedback that was misclassified as Rule Validation and pointed at a discovery tool.

coupledCauses.cause: validateClaimInventory checked structure, identity and accounting only; it did not check the necessary conditions for any valid Rule Set. Proof of necessity in APPLICABILITY_CONTRACT_ANALYSIS.json.
The Agent authored no SCOPE or CONDITION claim; instructions said "if needed".

ClaimInventory.rejected labelled every post-freeze tool rejection RULE_VALIDATION (and every discovery one CLAIM_INVENTORY_VALIDATION), so 8 rejections read as 8 validator failures with attempt counter 0.

Rejections carried requiredAction get_next_review_unit, no claim role, no expected argument and no applicability candidates. The rejected claims were a DEFINITION, a CONTEXT and a TEMPORAL_RULE claim (which argument each was placed in is not retained; every authoring call carried applicability_claim_ids), and the last call reference is consistent with an empty applicability list, which the pre-fix tool rejects.

rootCause.whyDeterministicTestsMissed: No test asked whether a frozen inventory could be authored from; fixtures always carried a CONDITION claim, and tool rejections were never counted separately from validator runs.

persistedCountsAreZeroBecause.proven: C: every authoring mutation was rejected inside the tool before the draft was stored (draft candidate fingerprint constant at 4da65c9a… across all eight events; requirement fingerprint constant at the digest of the empty list). The draft is Agent run-context state until submission, so the monitor (persisted rows) and the draft agree: 0.
notThe: A: no draft requirement existed in checkpoint state
B: not repeated structurally invalid packets; the tools are typed and incremental, not a packet

noProgress.classification: VALID mechanical detection, root-caused upstream; not weakened
noProgress.occurrences: identical state at events 1, 4 and 8; warned at 4, terminal at 8
noProgress.agentActionAfterFeedback: repeated the same malformed get_claim_inventory call shape (2 keys, 31 chars)
noProgress.note: The repeated read is not a wrongly detected loop: same gap, same unchanged draft, one warning. The defect is that the Agent could not make progress by any other route.

contractAnswers.packetSize: No giant packet: author_legal_requirement/author_assessment_rule are typed incremental upserts by key. The failures are not whole-packet repair instability.
contractAnswers.feedbackLocality: Local (ref = the offending claim) but not actionable: no role, no expected argument, wrong requiredAction.
contractAnswers.draftMutationModel: incremental canonical mutation, keyed upsert, rejected before storage
contractAnswers.monotonicValidation: Not applicable: the real validator never ran; accepted requirements are stored untouched by later rejections (tested).
contractAnswers.semanticVsBookkeeping: Role bucket choice is bookkeeping derivable from claim type and is now reported by get_claim_inventory (accountingRole) and in every mismatch; which claims aggregate into a Requirement and applicability grounding stay Agent decisions.

evidence.retainedLimits: The retained telemetry keeps tool names, argument KEYS and sizes but not argument values or tool result text; the exact limit/kind values of the three malformed reads and the requirement_key of ordinal 7 are therefore not recoverable and are marked as such.
